title: Open computational Linear A predecessor landscape and acquisition ledger
purpose: Identify openly readable/citable computational Linear A work that JANUS can reuse as methodological prior art, same-lineage reproducibility targets, external challenge sets, or source-quality warnings without confusing shared GORILA/Younger/lineara ancestry with independent transcription replication.

epistemic_firewall.rule: A public paper, web release, code repository, or independently implemented analysis does not become an independent transcription merely because its implementation is independent. Data/editorial lineage is classified separately from code/method independence.

acquisition_semantics.OBTAINED_EXACT_GIT_OBJECTS: JANUS retrieved immutable Git repository identity and one or more exact blob/commit identifiers through the connected GitHub API.
acquisition_semantics.PUBLIC_CONTENT_RETRIEVED: JANUS could inspect the public scholarly/web content through the current retrieval interface, but no local byte-for-byte archival SHA-256 is claimed.
acquisition_semantics.PUBLIC_METADATA_ONLY: Public metadata was located but a complete reusable primary data payload was not obtained.
acquisition_semantics.NOT_OBTAINED: No eligible complete payload obtained in this gate.
acquisition_semantics.binary_hash_rule: Do not fabricate a SHA-256 for public PDFs that were readable through the web interface but could not be materialized as exact local bytes. DOI/repository identity is recorded instead.

key_conclusion: The open ecosystem is rich enough to create a serious external methodology and same-lineage reproducibility lane, but it does not presently supply the exact alternate-editorial L3 transcription bytes required to unblock R3B. The correct JANUS move is therefore R3C, not relabelling shared-lineage work as independent replication.
